target_name: Two Sided Built Versus Bought Spread
rationale: This is an arithmetic blend of two already-evaluated archive signals whose combined performance is largely implied by construction — and because IND_RANK(oancf/at) and IND_RANK(NEG(oancf/at)) are near-complements, the "two-sided" spread reduces to a reweighting of the same cash rank times a composition contrast rather than a new economic mechanism.

Averaging the cash-level and cash-trend validators against the identical, already-tested composition leg is a cosmetic ensemble of two archive entries, and the stated justification (trend is orthogonal to RMW, so the blend keeps alpha while shedding factor loading) is asserted without evidence and cannot be inferred from the expression.

Substituting gdwl for intan in the confirmed short leg is a narrow one-variable variant and will be highly correlated with its parent, but it poses a genuine, unresolved measurement question (overpayment premium versus capitalisation per se) with a hypothesis and sign that match the expression.

target_name: Wide Sample Built Versus Bought Spread
rationale: This is a variant of a variant — the accrual analogue of a mechanical two-leg blend — and the archive has already run the accrual-versus-cash coverage comparison on the off-books composition leg, so the incremental information is minimal.

The indicator is badly contaminated because with COALESCE(xrd/xad, 0) any non-spending firm whose booked intangibles are merely amortising down scores a full five-year "builder" count, so the signal does not measure the intended expensing policy; the archive's gen-0 persistence count also already failed on the same discretisation logic.

target_name: Cash Return On Restated Net Worth
rationale: The equity-anchored cash-validated restatement is a defensible and untested step beyond the asset-anchored version, but ceq minus intan can be small or negative, making both ranked ratios mechanically unstable in exactly the goodwill-heavy firms the theme cares about, and the second leg overlaps materially with the archive's hidden-equity signal.
